import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 2, "lr": 0.002}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

VOX = 32
STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32

    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)

        super().__init__()
        self.Z = int(spec.Z)
        vin = 8 + 3 + self.Z
        self.vox = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(vin, VOX), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(VOX, VOX), nn.ReLU())
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels + 2 * VOX, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)

        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

        gl = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 2, "lr": 0.002}

D = 24
WIDTH = 32
P = 16
HID = 24


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.Z = int(spec.Z)
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in spec.footprints]
        vin = 15 + self.Z
        self.l1 = nn.Linear(vin, D)
        self.l2 = nn.Linear(3 * D, D)
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(2 * D + spec.in_channels, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.eh = nn.Linear(D, P)
        self.ef = nn.Linear(WIDTH, P)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * P, HID, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(HID, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH + D, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B, C, Y, X = obs.shape
        Z = self.Z
        v = obs[:, :4 * Z].reshape(B, 4, Z, Y, X)
        below = F.pad(v, (0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0))[:, :, :Z]
        above = F.pad(v, (0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1))[:, :, 1:]
        g = obs[:, 4 * Z:4 * Z + 3].unsqueeze(2).expand(B, 3, Z, Y, X)
        zpos = torch.eye(Z, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype).view(1, Z, Z, 1, 1).expand(B, Z, Z, Y, X)
        vin = torch.cat([v, below, above, g, zpos], dim=1).permute(0, 2, 3, 4, 1)
        h1 = F.relu(self.l1(vin))
        up = torch.cummax(h1, dim=1).values
        dn = torch.flip(torch.cummax(torch.flip(h1, [1]), dim=1).values, [1])
        h = F.relu(self.l2(torch.cat([h1, up, dn], dim=-1)))
        col = torch.cat([h.amax(1), h.mean(1)], dim=-1).permute(0, 3, 1, 2)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(torch.cat([col, obs], dim=1)))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        e = F.relu(self.eh(h) + self.ef(f.permute(0, 2, 3, 1)).unsqueeze(1))
        e = e.permute(0, 1, 4, 2, 3).reshape(B * Z, P, Y, X)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = e, e, e
            else:
                q = F.pad(e, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            s = out(F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))).reshape(B, Z, Y * X)
            res.append(torch.logsumexp(s, dim=1))
        place = torch.cat(res, dim=1)
        gl = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3)), h.amax((1, 2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(gl)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(gl).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):

        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))

            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels + self.nt, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())

        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B, C, Y, X = obs.shape
        m = mask[:, :self.n_place].to(obs.dtype).reshape(B, self.nt, Y, X)
        s = self.stem(torch.cat([obs, m], dim=1))
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        h = torch.cat([f, s], dim=1)
        place = self.head(h) + self.local(h).flatten(1)
        mm = self.miss(obs).amax((2, 3))
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3)), mm], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 1, "lr": 0.002, "gamma": 0.98, "gae_lambda": 0.95, "ent_coef": 0.0}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 1, "lr": 0.001, "gamma": 0.98, "gae_lambda": 0.95, "ent_coef": 0.003}

D = 64
HEADS = 4
FF = 128
NLAYERS = 2
PROJ = 32
HID = 32


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Block(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d, heads, ff):
        super().__init__()
        self.heads = heads
        self.n1 = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.qkv = nn.Linear(d, 3 * d)
        self.o = nn.Linear(d, d)
        self.n2 = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.ff = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(d, ff), nn.GELU(), nn.Linear(ff, d))

    def forward(self, x):
        B, N, Dm = x.shape
        t = self.qkv(self.n1(x)).reshape(B, N, 3, self.heads, Dm // self.heads).permute(2, 0, 3, 1, 4)
        a = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(t[0], t[1], t[2])
        a = a.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, N, Dm)
        x = x + self.o(a)
        return x + self.ff(self.n2(x))


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.nt = int(spec.n_types)
        self.n_place = int(spec.n_place)
        n = int(spec.Y) * int(spec.X)
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(spec.in_channels + self.nt, D), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(D, D))
        self.pos = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, n, D))
        nn.init.normal_(self.pos, std=0.02)
        self.blocks = nn.ModuleList([Block(D, HEADS, FF) for _ in range(NLAYERS)])
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(D)
        self.head = PoolHead(D, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * D, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B, C, Y, X = obs.shape
        m = mask[:, :self.n_place].to(obs.dtype).reshape(B, self.nt, Y, X)
        inp = torch.cat([obs, m], dim=1).flatten(2).transpose(1, 2)
        h = self.stem(inp) + self.pos
        for blk in self.blocks:
            h = blk(h)
        h = self.norm(h)
        f = h.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, D, Y, X)
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([h.mean(1), h.amax(1)], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ppo_epochs": 1, "lr": 0.002, "gamma": 0.98, "gae_lambda": 0.95, "ent_coef": 0.003}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 48
HHID = 32
DRED = 8
MF = 32


def mask_views(m, nt, Y, X):
    B = m.shape[0]
    v0 = m.reshape(B, nt, Y, X)
    v1 = m.reshape(B, Y, X, nt).permute(0, 3, 1, 2)
    v2 = m.reshape(B, nt, X, Y).permute(0, 1, 3, 2)
    v3 = m.reshape(B, X, Y, nt).permute(0, 3, 2, 1)
    return torch.cat([v0, v1, v2, v3], dim=1)


def flat_views(ls):
    return [ls[0].flatten(1),
            ls[1].permute(0, 2, 3, 1).flatten(1),
            ls[2].permute(0, 1, 3, 2).flatten(1),
            ls[3].permute(0, 3, 2, 1).flatten(1)]


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.nt = int(spec.n_types)
        self.Y = int(spec.Y)
        self.X = int(spec.X)
        self.n_place = int(spec.n_place)
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels + 4 * self.nt, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.hid = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, HHID, 3, padding=1)
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(HHID, self.nt, 3, padding=1) for _ in range(4)])
        self.red = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, DRED, 1)
        self.dense = nn.Linear(DRED * self.Y * self.X, self.n_place)
        self.mfeat = nn.Linear(self.n_place, MF)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH + MF, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        for o in self.outs:
            nn.init.normal_(o.weight, std=0.01)
            nn.init.zeros_(o.bias)
        nn.init.normal_(self.dense.weight, std=0.01)
        nn.init.zeros_(self.dense.bias)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        m = mask[:, :self.n_place].to(obs.dtype)
        mv = mask_views(m, self.nt, self.Y, self.X)
        s = self.stem(torch.cat([obs, mv], dim=1))
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        u = F.relu(self.hid(f))
        ls = [o(u) for o in self.outs]
        views = flat_views(ls)
        place = self.dense(F.relu(self.red(f)).flatten(1))
        for v in views:
            place = place + v
        mf = F.relu(self.mfeat(m))
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3)), mf], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

analyses.1: There are no results yet. The starting architecture scored 0.000 on both seeds, so I can't tell yet whether the problem is too little training or too little capacity. Exact builds need every placement to be right. A brick placement is correct when, in every column under its footprint, the lowest missing target layer equals the brick's landing layer, which is the highest build height under the footprint. That is a per-column computation (lowest missing layer, build height) followed by min/max pooling over the footprint. The starting network's pool head already fits that min/max structure, so it may simply be undertrained. All three candidates use the same recipe (2 PPO epochs instead of 4, lr 2e-3). This gives about 1.9× more environment steps for the same compute. Candidate A changes only the recipe. B and C add architecture changes on top of it, so comparing them with A isolates the architecture effect.
analyses.2: All four results are exactly 0 on dev, and train success over the last 10% of training was also 0. The tests so far were: the baseline with 2 epochs and lr 2e-3, a stem skip with a deeper head, and a per-voxel column encoder. None of them got a single exact build, so I can't yet tell whether the bottleneck is the recipe or the representation. Each change on its own scored 0, so I can only say that none of them was enough. The placement rule depends on layers: a brick lands at the highest build height under its footprint, and it is correct only if the target is filled at that layer and nothing is sealed below it. The 2D column models never compare features layer by layer across a footprint. This round runs a 2×2 test: a recipe change (1 epoch for more samples, a longer horizon, less entropy) on the baseline, and a new per-layer footprint head under each recipe.
analyses.3: All six trials scored exactly 0, on dev and on training success. That includes three column/voxel encoders, two recipes (2 epochs, and 1 epoch with gamma 0.98) and up to 3.3× more samples. The 0s cannot rank the ideas, so what matters is finding anything above 0. Three explanations are left. (1) The shaped reward pays for sloppy bricks: a brick with 3 correct cells and 1 extra still scores positive. Meanwhile the entropy bonus (0.01×ln257≈0.055) is as large as the per-step reward, which keeps the policy diffuse. (2) The world may use a different anchor convention, and the top-left footprint pooling then mis-aligns. Passing the legality mask in as input would show the real convention. (3) DONE comes from coarse global pooling, so the agent may never stop at the right moment, and any placement after an exact build ruins it. This round tests each: ent 0 on the baseline, an anchor-agnostic head with mask input, and global attention for context-aware DONE.
analyses.4: All 9 trials scored exactly 0, on dev and on training success. That includes the baseline under four recipes, three column encoders, per-layer heads, a local 3x3 head with mask input, and a transformer. Seed noise can't explain a uniform zero across such varied networks and recipes. A broken assumption seems more likely. The task warns that the world may differ from its description, and the most likely broken assumption is how action indices map to cells. Every head so far used the type-major layout (t, y, x). If the world uses type-minor order, swapped x/y, or a transposed grid, then every spatial head scores the wrong cells, and no recipe or encoder can fix that. In this final round I test heads that don't depend on the layout: an ensemble of four permuted layouts plus a dense learned head, and a purely dense head. Any score above zero beats the baseline.
